### 🔒 Privacy & Exclusion Guarantee
Your private information (passwords, recovery seed phrases, private keys, keystores, personal government IDs, or tax details) **will never be committed to the GitHub repository**. 

[`gitignore`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/.gitignore) has been updated to strictly ignore and block:
* Private keys & certificates (`*.keystore`, `*.jks`, `*.p12`, `*.key`, `*.pem`, `*.mobileprovision`, `*.p8`)
* Environment variables and secrets (`*.env`, `secrets/`, `credentials.json`)
* Local build artifacts and binaries (`*.apk`, `*.aab`, `build/`)

### 📋 App Store & Google Play Submission Kit Ready

I have prepared the complete submission package in the artifact:
👉 **[App Store & Google Play Submission Kit](file:///home/runner/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/6d82d2e9-c2ec-4fd7-aa63-7eae12b5a0a3/SUBMISSION_KIT.md)**

It provides ready-to-copy answers for every mandatory portal questionnaire:
1. **Store Metadata:** App name, subtitle, category (Finance/Utilities), keywords, and full promotional description.
2. **Apple App Privacy Nutrition Label:** Exactly how to answer the data collection questions (*"No, we do not collect data from this app"* + `UserDefaults` `CA92.1` manifest reason).
3. **Apple Export Compliance:** Exact answers for cryptography exemption (standard public digital signature exemption).
4. **Google Play Data Safety Form:** Accurate answers for zero data collection and encrypted transit.
5. **App Review Guideline 3.1.5(a) Compliance Notes:** The mandatory non-custodial declaration and Sepolia Testnet testing instructions so Apple and Google review teams do not reject the app.

### ✍️ Details to Provide for Custom Kit Filling

Please provide any of the following details you would like filled in:

1. **Developer / Organization Name:** Your individual developer name or company/organization entity name.
2. **Public Support Contact Email:** The email address you want displayed to users and reviewers (e.g., `support@...`).
3. **Official Website / Domain (Optional):** If you have a custom landing page or website; otherwise we default to the project documentation links.
4. **Apple Developer Team ID (Optional):** If you want Xcode [`project.yml`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/project.yml) configured to automatically select your team for code signing.
5. **Android Release Package & Keystore Alias (Optional):** If you have a specific keystore alias or package name preference (currently configured as `com.vaulteth.app`).

### 📱 Android Implementation Update
The Android application has been fully built in Jetpack Compose to match the iOS version:
* **Architecture:** 4-tab Sovereign Obsidian layout ([`VaultHomeScreen`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/android/app/src/main/java/com/vaulteth/app/ui/screens/VaultHomeScreen.kt), [`WalletsScreen`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/android/app/src/main/java/com/vaulteth/app/ui/screens/WalletsScreen.kt), [`ActivityScreen`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/android/app/src/main/java/com/vaulteth/app/ui/screens/ActivityScreen.kt), [`SettingsScreen`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/android/app/src/main/java/com/vaulteth/app/ui/screens/SettingsScreen.kt)).
* **Multi-Chain & Keys:** Dynamic JSON-RPC for 9+ chains, BIP-39 mnemonic engine, EIP-1559 transaction signing, Base58 Solana derivation, and Bech32 Bitcoin derivation.
* **Security:** AES-256 encryption via Android Keystore and `EncryptedSharedPreferences`.
* **Testing:** All unit tests compiled and passed (`BUILD SUCCESSFUL`). All changes are saved.
